title: A Love Reunited
content:
For a few moments, I didn't know what to say.

I was completely confused.

The same girl who had ignored every one of my calls...

The same girl who had blocked my number...

Was now speaking as though nothing had ever separated us.

Unable to understand what was happening, I finally asked,

"What happened all these days? Why did you ignore me like that?"

There was a brief silence on the other end of the call.

Then Shreya began to speak.

"It all started on the day you were suspended."

"After I reached home, my parents found out everything."

"My father was furious. He scolded me so badly that he was even ready to throw me out of the house."

She paused for a moment before continuing.

"But my mother somehow stopped him."

"After that, my father refused to send me back to college."

"My studies were affected badly."

"When our Intermediate Public Examinations began, I wanted to tell you everything."

"But during those days... you ignored me."

"My chance to explain everything was gone."

"After that, my father never allowed me to contact you."

"And when I joined college..."

"He changed my phone number."

"I didn't know anything about you."

"I didn't even have the contact details of any of your friends."

As she finished speaking, I remained speechless.

Every misunderstanding I had carried in my heart for months suddenly began to fall apart.

I had blamed Shreya...

When, in reality, she had been fighting battles I never knew existed.

Guilt slowly settled inside me.

For the first time, I realized how unfairly I had judged her.

If only I had trusted her a little longer...

If only I had tried to understand her instead of believing my own fears...

Perhaps neither of us would have suffered so much.

I closed my eyes for a moment and let out a slow breath.

Yet one question still remained unanswered.

"What about Karthik?" I asked hesitantly.

There was a soft laugh from the other end.

"I have two things to tell you," she said.

"Will you listen to me until the end?"

"Of course," I replied without hesitation.

Shreya took a deep breath before she continued.

"First..."

"My friend Ruthika and Karthik are in a relationship."

"They've loved each other for a long time."

"I see them together almost every day in college."

For a brief moment, I simply closed my eyes.

The weight that had been crushing my heart slowly began to disappear.

It felt as though someone had lifted a mountain from my chest.

The fear that had haunted me for months slowly melted away.

I couldn't stop smiling.

Then Shreya spoke again.

"And the second thing..."

Her voice grew softer.

"You're the first person who ever made me fall in love."

"The first person who truly cared for me."

"The one who always stood beside me whenever I needed someone."

"The one who gave me a shoulder to lean on."

"The one who always knew how to make me smile."

She paused.

I could hear her breathing.

It felt as though she was gathering every ounce of courage she had left.

Then, in the softest voice, she finally confessed.

"It's you, Rah."

"No matter how much life tried to separate us... my heart never stopped choosing you."

"I want you in my life... forever."

"I want to spend every happiness and every hardship with you."

"Will you accept my proposal?"

"I love you, sweetheart."

For a few seconds...

I forgot how to breathe.

The world around me disappeared.

The noise outside...

The people around me...

Everything faded into silence.

All I could hear was the sound of her voice echoing inside my heart.

I couldn't believe what I had just heard.

It felt less like reality and more like a beautiful dream.

To make sure I wasn't imagining it, I pinched myself without even realizing it.

The slight sting on my hand was enough to tell me...

It was real.

Every fear...

Every sleepless night...

Every unanswered question...

Every tear I had silently shed...

Had finally found an answer.

Months of pain vanished in a single moment.

A smile slowly spread across my face.

My eyes became moist, not because I was hurt...

But because I had never imagined that the person I loved with all my heart loved me just as deeply.

For the first time in months, I felt complete again.

With my heart overflowing with happiness, I smiled through my tears and softly replied,

"I love you too."
